scripts.dev: concurrently "yarn workspace server dev" "yarn workspace app serve"
scripts.start: concurrently "yarn workspace server start" "yarn workspace app serve"
scripts.clean: yarn workspace server clean && yarn workspace app clean
scripts.env:check: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); console.log('配置檢查:', { HOST: process.env.SERVER_HOST, PORT: process.env.SERVER_PORT, API_URL: process.env.API_BASE_URL });"
